title: Starting the lab notebook
excerpt: Why this log exists, and — since it's the first entry — a quick note on how it publishes itself. The Research section of this site is for finished thinking; this log is the opposite: small experiments, half-working ideas, dead ends, the kind of note that's useful for a day and forgotten by the next.
